dialogues.speaker: Xinxiu
dialogues.text: This will be yet another feat to tack on to your deeds in Liyue!

dialogues.speaker: Xinxiu
dialogues.text: I never thought I'd get to witness an occasion like this in person!

dialogues.speaker: Rongjiang
dialogues.text: Word is that the prize has been stolen and that the final match has been postponed. I can't believe it!

dialogues.speaker: Xinxiu
dialogues.text: Who would dare steal from The Crux Fleet?
